items.title: North Korean Hackers Are Hiding Malware Servers Inside Empty Crypto Transfers
items.description: North Korean-linked attackers are using a new way to hide the servers that control malware. The method places a command server address inside an empty Ethereum transaction, making the activity look like a normal crypto transfer rather than a malware signal.
